title: CoreWeave leases 250 MW at Applied Digital's North Dakota campus (~$7B)

sources.quote: Over the approximately 15-year term, Applied Digital anticipates generating approximately $7 billion in total revenue from the leases.

explain: CoreWeave, an AI cloud company, signed two roughly 15-year leases to rent 250 megawatts of data center space at Applied Digital's Ellendale, North Dakota campus (later named Polaris Forge 1). Applied Digital expects about $7 billion in rent over the term.
